name: Ripple in Still Water (Combat)
body:
Like a calm river’s hidden currents, your stilled mind conceals deadly intent.

Prerequisites: Ki pool class feature, kineticist level 1st.

Benefit: Your kineticist levels and your levels in the class that granted you the ki pool class feature stack for determining the number of points in your ki pool each day and the base damage of your kinetic blasts. In addition, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for using your kinetic blast while threatened (neither from it being a spell-like ability nor from it being a ranged attack).

Divergent Paths – Roil Dancer, © 2017, Dreamscarred Press.
